WITH prefiltered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
), customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
        SUM(sr_fee) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN prefiltered_date ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk
), store_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        ctr_store_sk,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_ctr_total_return_120
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT 
    c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN'
JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
JOIN store_averages sa ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = sa.ctr_store_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.avg_ctr_total_return_120
ORDER BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100
